name: terra-observation-logger
description: A local-first nature journal with seven organism choices, group-specific mock photo examples, and Projects / Field Summary with a shared site/species column. Add to TERRA project reuses observation IDs. Preserves legacy categories and six-field JSON. Includes staged provenance definitions and separate unconnected BOLD/GenBank plans with temporary DNA syntax previews. No remote calls, sequence persistence, uploads or publishing; documented staged integration roadmap.
